name: testland/test-case-ideation-from-story
description: Use for any question or task about turning a user story, ticket or spec into test cases, including one-line stories whose gaps QA finds only after coding. Produces a markdown test case matrix (id, title, precondition, steps, expected, tier) covering happy, alternate, boundary and negative paths, agreed before automation and ready for TestRail, Qase or Xray.
